newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends slightly up vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends slightly up vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended slightly up at 42.8450/8470 to the dollar in interbank trading ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend against a previous close at 42.8470/8485, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted steady at 42.8470/8490 per dollar in early trade but slightly edged gained at close as call money rates continued to remain high.
The call money was traded at Wednesday's level at 7.5 to 8.0 percent, dealers said.
Banks in Bangladesh close transactions by mid-day on the Thursday.
